name: Earth Elemental
description: An elemental is a powerful fusion of raw magic and elements resulting in a formidable foe that can channel magic. Elementals are typically prevalent in groups and in locations that are infused with ancient magic or extraplanar energy.

actions.name: Earthen Blow
actions.description: The Earth Elemental strikes out with earthen limbs, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Crystalize
actions.description: In response to taking damage, the Earth Elementaling causes the damage to be halved. If the damage is already halved due to the Elemental trait, it deals no damage.

actions.name: Hungry Land
actions.description: The Earth Elemental targets a large or smaller creature that is occupying at least one tile within 4 units that is made of natural terrain and causes the ground to become unstable, pulling the creature into the earth and restricting their ability to defend themselves. If the target fails a strength check of 9, they suffer a 1d4 penalty to dodge and block until the start of their next turn.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Earth
traits.description: The Earth Elementaling can move through natural terrain as long as it ends it's turn in open space.
